title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 25
description:
Experience ultimate comfort and style with the Jeminise Personalized Baseball Comforter Set. This bedding set, perfect for baseball players and fans, combines soft, durable materials with a spirited design, making it an ideal gift or a fantastic addition to any sports-themed room.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: A thoughtful present for baseball lovers, men, women, moms, dads, and perfect for Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques for long-lasting dye and fade prevention, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Material Details: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel, with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat for quick drying and enhanced fluffiness. For best results, wash in a mesh laundry bag.
  • Custom Options: Includes options for two text inputs for personalization.
  • Product Style: Features a dynamic Baseball pattern, perfect for sports decor.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
